notes: Two upright subgroup diagrams occupy the original top. All six spheres, their captions and the mapping table are head-to-foot relative to them. The complete proposed TikZ preserves that 180-degree orientation; sphere A's small crossed note retains its additional local reversal.

The four nearby curled signs are read mathcal E from their rounded connected lobes, not H's Sigma. This is a local shape comparison, not an imported assumption about the similarly written fibre-functor symbol elsewhere.

The upper-square argument remains Pi|E. A stabilizer construction would normally have Ssgr(pi)/pi under a pi-set hypothesis, but that expectation is not substituted for the overworked source sign; the source may contain a slip or unfinished rewriting.

The brace caption reads mathcal E unsure opère|opérant ci-dessus. The apparent C subscript 0 is the opening o of the following verb. The 2/z-like overworked mark remains uncertain both in identity and in independent status. No final crossed t is securely visible.
The two equals bars and final opening parenthesis survive outside the central cancellation. C's deletion extent is retained at medium confidence; H's deleted simeq and parenthesis are not copied.

Sphere C's R_infinity^- is live unsure; the uncertainty includes deletion state because its crossings cannot be distinguished from retracing of the polar rim. The two cancelled draft spheres have independently visible large cancellation strokes and remain reproduced in full.

H's sphere-C body reads (a_1^- a_1^+)^{-1}, but H's immediately following re-reading note corrects this to (a_1^{--}a_1^{-+}) without an inverse. That corrected reading agrees with the present one. The superseded body is documented here, not counted as an extra change.

H differences for drawings concern concrete supplied labels, arrows, junctions or decorations. Prose-versus-TikZ representation alone is not a change. External H drawing files were not supplied, so the underlying project drawings cannot be assessed.
The first mapping arrow has a plain tail; the next two have mapsto bars. This exact-form difference does not change the point images and is not mathematically consequential.

Only two conditional mathematical checks were performed: stabilizer descent to subgroup conjugacy classes and descent of an extension's conjugation action through inner automorphisms. No proof of the ramification claims, pictured path-product identities, symmetry assertion or realization of the mapping table is claimed.
The leaf has handwritten page number 109, with no title/date. No watermark, speck or bleed-through is promoted to text. Light continuous construction strokes within the sphere drawings are retained.

Certainty-only resolutions have no separate change rows. Explicit H uncertainty macros and explicit prose lecture incertaine attached to a reading both count as marked_in_H; this convention is stated so the flags can be interpreted.

The separate glyph right of the left 0 in cancelled sphere E is retained as deleted unsure b|6: a stem rises above a lower loop, but crossing ink prevents certainty. The small lower interior 0 is left of its isolated point, not right as coded by C.

The brace annotation is now reconstructed graphically: the 2/z-like shape lies over its left portion and is entangled with the overworked E, rather than being typeset as a centered overset or an exponent. The existing upper-square crop was revisited for this placement; no further crop was made.

check_events.statement: If E_0 is a left pi-set, x maps to Stab_pi(x), inducing E_0/pi -> Ssgr(pi)/pi.
check_events.outcome: Directly checked: h fixes g.x iff g^{-1}hg fixes x, so Stab_pi(g.x)=g Stab_pi(x)g^{-1}. Passing to subgroup conjugacy classes makes the map constant on pi-orbits. This does not resolve the written overwritten argument.

check_events.outcome: Checked representative independence: replacing e by p.e changes eHe^{-1} to its p-conjugate, hence not its pi-conjugacy class. The action factors through Gamma. No splitting or direct product is inferred from the written Gamma.pi.

audit_notes: The independent second reading preserves all accepted text, formula labels, cancellations, source marks and earlier lexical doubts. Its substantive changes concern literal drawing detail. The upright square has an incomplete one-branch terminal on the left vertical connector. The rotated figures contain omitted heads on sphere A and on sphere C; sphere D has a bottom turning head that the accepted draft placed at the right, and a visibly open infinity loop. On sphere B and the cancelled sphere E, the remaining real branch/return strokes are reproduced without claiming a complete conventional head where overtracing prevents one from being isolated. The small loop beside E's 1 is open at the bottom and retains its distinct right terminal head. The cancelled sphere F retains a separate dash near infinity and three separate exterior strokes, without an inferred connection to its interior diagonal. An independent unlabelled curve between spheres A and B is added beside that parent block in the inventory. Its only new crop clips one extremity; the whole isolated contour was seen in the native bottom half and was independently checked there by the main reader. The mapping table's first and third terminal shapes are drawn literally; all source and target values are unchanged. H's drawing implementations are unavailable. Its generic prose was not treated as a claim about local geometry or as an omission of a complete drawing; H differences are confined to the explicit left-vertical arrow and the explicit mapping glyphs. No new mathematical slip was identified, and no theorem, identity, or topology claim was proved or computed during this audit.
